newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to edge towards 113-30 support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to edge towards 113-30 support.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE will continue to consolidate, moving sideways to slightly lower and may slip down to 113-30 on Tuesday, technical analysts said.
"We had a quiet inside day on Monday and from here we need to break 114-17, to trigger further losses to Friday's low at 114-13," said Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London.
"With many technicals turning lower we could see a test down to 113-30."
September gilt futures opened at 114-27 on Tuesday, up 6/32 on the day.
The contract formed a low at 114-17 on Monday, while 113-30 was the low on July 15.
Technical analysts at a European bank in London said a reversal had been put in place by Friday's close.
"That could bode well for bears, although nothing too great," they said in a research note.
They said first trendline support ran through 114-00, with a break of that opening the way for a move to the 113-00, 112-16 area, retracing nearly the whole of the rally from late May.
But if the contract failed to break through support, Branigan said there would be more sideways action on Monday.
"A move above 114-30, the 38 percent retracement of the move from 115-25 to 114-13, would trigger gains of further corrective action up to a maximum of 115-09," he said.
Branigan said that level is close to a 62 percent retracement of the same move.
At the short end, December short sterling was at 92.49, up one basis point from Monday's settlement.
